one_line: Paramount Chandela ruler of Kalinjar who faced Mahmud of Ghazni with fortress diplomacy on the northern frontier.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early-40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jawline, medium-brown north Indian complexion, straight prominent nose, neatly groomed mustache with a short pointed beard, intense almond-shaped eyes with a steady gaze, default expression calm and strategic with a slight stern focus.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted at the center and tied back into a mid-length warrior’s knot at the nape, a narrow gold circlet resting low on the forehead with a small central red cabochon, and a simple cloth band beneath to hold the hair in place.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate early-11th-century central Indian royal-warrior attire: a knee-length, sleeveless quilted coat of mail-like padded cotton (zabhā) dyed deep indigo with subtle vertical stitching, worn over a full-sleeved reddish-brown cotton tunic; a broad woven sash in maroon and mustard wrapped tightly at the waist and knotted over the left hip, with the free end hanging; below, off-white cotton churidar-style fitted trousers gathered at the ankles; on top, a light ochre cotton angavastra draped from the left shoulder across the torso and back like a hero’s scarf; sturdy brown leather boots rising just above the ankle with simple lacing; jewelry kept regal but not ostentatious—medium-width gold armlets on both upper arms engraved with simple floral motifs, a single short gold necklace with a small leaf-shaped pendant, and plain gold stud earrings.
appearance.signature: A single-edged, gently curved early Indo-Persian style sword (precursor to the tulwar) with a broad steel blade, an iron hilt wrapped in dark leather, and a simple circular disc pommel, worn in a brown leather scabbard suspended from a diagonal belt crossing his chest from right shoulder to left hip.

ref_desc: Vidyādhara Chandela is a mid-40s athletic north Indian king with an oval medium-brown face, black hair in a back knot under a gold circlet, wearing an indigo padded war-coat over a reddish-brown tunic, off-white trousers, ochre angavastra, gold armlets, and carrying a curved sword in a brown scabbard on a diagonal chest belt.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vidyādhara Chandela, an early-11th-century central Indian king and warrior: he is in his late 30s to early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered, with an oval medium-brown face, sharp jawline, straight nose, intense almond-shaped eyes, and a neatly groomed mustache with a short pointed beard, his default expression calm and strategic. His thick black hair is parted at the center and tied into a mid-length knot at the nape, held by a narrow gold circlet with a small red gem at the center resting low on his forehead and a hidden cloth band beneath. He wears a knee-length sleeveless deep indigo quilted padded war-coat with visible vertical stitching over a full-sleeved reddish-brown cotton tunic, and a broad maroon and mustard woven sash tightly wrapped at his waist and knotted at his left hip with the end hanging. His off-white fitted cotton trousers gather at the ankles, and a light ochre cotton angavastra is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and back like a heroic scarf, all modest and fully covering his body. He has simple gold armlets on both upper arms with subtle floral engravings, a short gold necklace with a leaf pendant, and plain gold stud earrings, and wears sturdy brown leather ankle boots with simple lacing. His signature weapon is a gently curved single-edged steel sword with an iron hilt wrapped in dark leather and a disc pommel, sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard hanging from a diagonal belt crossing from his right shoulder to his left hip; show the sword clearly at his side and emphasize the deep indigo, maroon, reddish-brown, ochre, and off-white color palette in a clean character turnaround style.
